description: TfL publishes the locations of bus stands in London. The source describes a stand-location layer and does not claim MasterMap alignment. Stands provide a distinct operational facility from passenger stops, bus shelters and bus stations. The layer metadata establishes a spatial inventory, not observed vehicle movements, utilisation or available stand capacity. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
